data.animaCaption: On the left, Ayachi Nene smiles warmly in a camel duffel coat, red plaid scarf, and white beret holding a hot coffee cup; on the right, Shiki Natsume stands poised in a sleek black wool coat over an ivory turtleneck, framed as a crisp winter fashion magazine cover.
data.promptProse: A clean minimalist winter fashion artbook cover photographed in crisp sunlit snow along a warm stone avenue with generous uncluttered sky space. On the left, Ayachi Nene wears a camel wool duffel coat, red plaid scarf, and white knit beret, smiling brightly toward the camera with a paper coffee cup; on the right, Shiki Natsume stands shoulder to shoulder in a tailored black wool coat over an ivory cashmere turtleneck with poised cool charm. The layout contains strictly two clean editorial titles and zero side blurbs, barcodes, or small text: title at the top: "HUIYU ATELIER" and headline at the bottom right: "WINTER SPECIAL".
data.story: 清透冬日微雪中的双女主时尚杂志特刊封面：左面是暖驼色牛角扣大衣与白贝雷帽的温柔笑意，右面是黑大衣配象牙白羊绒的冷冽气场，顶部干净利落的刊头排字让整张画面宛如实体精装特刊。
